meta.model_usage: display_only; does not feed Model A, game projections, signals, or bracketology
meta.methodology: Current-roster personnel model blended with a continuity-scaled carry from only the latest completed season. Returning minutes, incoming transfer production and recruiting replace multi-season team-name carryover.
meta.validation_target: future-season rank ordering, not betting ROI
meta.current_season_update_policy: Verified current-season adjusted efficiency blends from 0% to an 85% cap over the first 12 games. The immutable preseason board remains the movement reference.

roster_model.overlap_interpretation: Descriptive only. End-of-season top-25 membership is not the preseason power-rating target and is not a promotion criterion.
